executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version

through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).

analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

0 # lazygit

A simple terminal UI for git commands. ## Description Lazygit is a terminal UI for git commands that makes working with git easier and more intuitive. Instead of typing complex git commands, you can use a simple visual interface to perform common git operations. ## Features ### Stage individual lines Press space on the selected line to stage it, or press `v` to start selecting a range of lines. You can also press `a` to select the entirety of the current hunk. ### Interactive Rebase Press `i` to start an interactive rebase. Then squash (`s`), fixup (`f`), drop (`d`), edit (`e`), move up (`ctrl+k`) or move down (`ctrl+j`) any of TODO commits, before continuing the rebase by bringing up the rebase options menu with `m` and then selecting `continue`. ### Cherry-pick Press `shift+c` on a commit to copy it and press `shift+v` to paste (cherry-pick) it. ### Bisect Press `b` in the commits view to mark a commit as good/bad in order to begin a git bisect. ### Nuke the working tree For when you really want to just get rid of anything that shows up when you run `git status`, press `shift+d` to bring up the reset options menu and then select the 'nuke' option. ### Amend an old commit Pressing `shift+a` on any commit will amend that commit with the currently staged changes (running an interactive rebase in the background). ### Filter You can filter a view with `/`. For example, filter down the branches view and then hit `enter` to view its commits. ### Worktrees You can create worktrees to have multiple branches going at once without the need for stashing or creating WIP commits when switching between them. Press `w` in the branches view to create a worktree from the selected branch and switch to it. ### Undo Lazygit provides powerful undo capabilities. See the documentation for details. ### Commit graph Lazygit displays a visual commit graph showing the relationship between commits. ## Installation Lazygit is available through various package managers: ### Binary Releases Download pre-built binaries from the releases page. ### Homebrew (macOS and Linux) ```sh brew install lazygit ``` ### MacPorts (macOS) ```sh sudo port install lazygit ``` ### Scoop (Windows) ```sh scoop install lazygit ``` ### Chocolatey (Windows) ```sh choco install lazygit ``` ### Winget (Windows) ```sh winget install -e --id=JesseDuffield.lazygit ``` ### Arch Linux ```sh sudo pacman -S lazygit ``` ### Fedora / CentOS Stream ```sh sudo dnf install lazygit ``` ### Debian and Ubuntu ```sh sudo apt install lazygit ``` ### NixOS ```sh nix-env -iA nixpkgs.lazygit ``` ### FreeBSD ```sh pkg install lazygit ``` ### Conda ```sh conda install -c conda-forge lazygit ``` And many other package managers. Check your system's package manager for availability. ## Usage Call `lazygit` in your terminal inside a git repository: ```sh $ lazygit ``` You can also add an alias for convenience: ```sh echo "alias lg='lazygit'" >> ~/.zshrc ``` ### Changing Directory On Exit If you change repos in lazygit and want your shell to change directory into that repo on exiting lazygit, add this to your `~/.zshrc` (or other rc file): ```sh lg() { export LAZYGIT_NEW_DIR_FILE=~/.lazygit/newdir lazygit "$@" if [ -f $LAZYGIT_NEW_DIR_FILE ]; then cd "$(cat $LAZYGIT_NEW_DIR_FILE)" rm -f $LAZYGIT_NEW_DIR_FILE > /dev/null fi } ``` Then `source ~/.zshrc` and from now on when you call `lg` and exit you'll switch directories to whatever you were in inside lazygit. To override this behaviour you can exit using `shift+Q` rather than just `q`. ## Configuration ### Config File Location Default path for the config file: - Linux: `~/.config/lazygit/config.yml` - MacOS: `~/Library/Application Support/lazygit/config.yml` - Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\lazygit\config.yml` You can create repo-specific config files in `/.git/lazygit.yml`. Settings in these files override settings in the global config file. ### Keybindings Lazygit provides extensive keyboard shortcuts for all operations. See the keybindings documentation for a complete list. ### Custom Commands Lazygit has a flexible custom command system that allows you to extend its functionality with your own commands. ## Documentation For more detailed documentation, see the `docs/` directory, which includes: - Configuration guide (Config.md) - Custom command keybindings (Custom_Command_Keybindings.md) - Custom pagers (Custom_Pagers.md) - Undo/Redo functionality (Undoing.md) - And more ## FAQ ### What do the commit colors represent? - Green: The local commit is not yet on the remote - Yellow: The commit is on both local and remote - Red: The local commit is not on the remote but the remote has commits that the local doesn't ## License See LICENSE file for details. --- DOC INDEX --- # Documentation Overview * [Configuration](./Config.md). * [Custom Commands](./Custom_Command_Keybindings.md) * [Custom Pagers](./Custom_Pagers.md) * [Dev docs](./dev) * [Keybindings](./keybindings) * [Undo/Redo](./Undoing.md) * [Range Select](./Range_Select.md) * [Searching/Filtering](./Searching.md) * [Stacked Branches](./Stacked_Branches.md) --- CLI HELP --- executable Usage: executable [git-arg] Positional Variables: git-arg Panel to focus upon opening lazygit. Accepted values (based on git terminology): status, branch, log, stash. Ignored if --filter arg is passed. Flags: -h --help Displays help with available flag, subcommand, and positional value parameters. -p --path Path of git repo. (equivalent to --work-tree= --git-dir=/.git/) -f --filter Path to filter on in `git log -- `. When in filter mode, the commits, reflog, and stash are filtered based on the given path, and some operations are restricted -v --version Print the current version -d --debug Run in debug mode with logging (see --logs flag below). Use the LOG_LEVEL env var to set the log level (debug/info/warn/error) -l --logs Tail lazygit logs (intended to be used when `lazygit --debug` is called in a separate terminal tab) --profile Start the profiler and serve it on http port 6060. See CONTRIBUTING.md for more info. -c --config Print the default config -cd --print-config-dir Print the config directory -ucd --use-config-dir override default config directory with provided directory -w --work-tree equivalent of the --work-tree git argument -g --git-dir equivalent of the --git-dir git argument -ucf --use-config-file Comma separated list to custom config file(s) -sm --screen-mode The initial screen-mode, which determines the size of the focused panel. Valid options: 'normal' (default), 'half', 'full'

- Linux: `~/.config/lazygit/config.yml`
- MacOS: `~/Library/Application\ Support/lazygit/config.yml`
- Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\lazygit\config.yml` (default location, but it will also be found in `%APPDATA%\lazygit\config.yml`

For old installations (slightly embarrassing: I didn't realise at the time that you didn't need to supply a vendor name to the path so I just used my name):

- Linux: `~/.config/jesseduffield/lazygit/config.yml`
- MacOS: `~/Library/Application\ Support/jesseduffield/lazygit/config.yml`
- Windows: `%APPDATA%\jesseduffield\lazygit\config.yml`

If you want to change the config directory:

- MacOS: `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$HOME/.config"`

In addition to the global config file you can create repo-specific config files in `<repo>/.git/lazygit.yml`. Settings in these files override settings in the global config file. In addition, files called `.lazygit.yml` in any of the parent directories of a repo will also be loaded; this can be useful if you have settings that you want to apply to a group of repositories.

JSON schema is available for `config.yml` so that IntelliSense in Visual Studio Code (completion and error checking) is automatically enabled when the [YAML Red Hat][yaml] extension is installed. However, note that automatic schema detection only works if your config file is in one of the standard paths mentioned above. If you override the path to the file, you can still make IntelliSense work by adding

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/master/schema/config.json
```

to the top of your config file or via [Visual Studio Code settings.json config][settings].

[yaml]: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=redhat.vscode-yaml
[settings]: https://github.com/redhat-developer/vscode-yaml#associating-a-schema-to-a-glob-pattern-via-yamlschemas

## Default

This is only meant as a reference for what config options exist, and what their default values are. It is not meant to be copied and pasted into your config file as a whole; that's not a good idea for several reasons. It is recommended to include only those settings in your config file that you actually want to change.

# Fixup Commits

## Background

There's this common scenario that you have a PR in review, the reviewer is
requesting some changes, and you make those changes and would normally simply
squash them into the original commit that they came from. If you do that,
however, there's no way for the reviewer to see what you changed. You could just
make a separate commit with those changes at the end of the branch, but this is
not ideal because it results in a git history that is not very clean.

To help with this, git has a concept of fixup commits: you do make a separate
commit, but the subject of this commit is the string "fixup! " followed by the
original commit subject. This both tells the reviewer what's going on (you are
making a change that you later will squash into the designated commit), and it
provides an easy way to actually perform this squash operation when you are
ready to do that (before merging).

## Creating fixup commits

You could of course create fixup commits manually by typing in the commit
message with the prefix yourself. But lazygit has an easier way to do that:
in the Commits view, select the commit that you want to create a fixup for, and
press shift-F (for "Create fixup commit for this commit"). This automatically
creates a commit with the appropriate subject line.

Don't confuse this with the lowercase "f" command ("Fixup commit"); that one
squashes the selected commit into its parent, this is not what we want here.

## Creating amend commits

There's a special type of fixup commit that uses "amend!" instead of "fixup!" in
the commit message subject; in addition to fixing up the original commit with
changes it allows you to also (or only) change the commit message of the
original commit. The menu that appears when pressing shift-F has options for
both of these; they bring up a commit message panel similar to when you reword a
commit, but then create the "amend!" commit containing the new message. Note
that in that panel you only type the new message as you want it to be
eventually; lazygit then takes care of formatting the "amend!" commit
appropriately for you (with the subject of your new message moving into the body
of the "amend!" commit).

## Squashing fixup commits

When you're ready to merge the branch and want to squash all these fixup commits
that you created, that's very easy to do: select the first commit of your branch
and hit shift-S (for "Squash all 'fixup!' commits above selected commit
(autosquash)"). Boom, done.

## Finding the commit to create a fixup for

When you are making changes to code that you changed earlier in a long branch,
it can be tedious to find the commit to squash it into. Lazygit has a command to
help you with this, too: in the Files view, press ctrl-f to select the right
base commit in the Commits view automatically. From there, you can either press
shift-F to create a fixup commit for it, or shift-A to amend your changes into
the commit if you haven't published your branch yet.

If you have many modifications in your working copy, it is a good idea to stage
related changes that are meant to go into the same fixup commit; if no changes
are staged, ctrl-f works on all unstaged modifications, and then it might show
an error if it finds multiple different base commits. If you are interested in
what the command does to do its magic, and how you can help it work better, you
may want to read the [design document](dev/Find_Base_Commit_For_Fixup_Design.md)
that describes this.
# Working with stacked branches

When working on a large branch it can often be useful to break it down into
smaller pieces, and it can help to create separate branches for each independent
chunk of changes. For example, you could have one branch for preparatory
refactorings, one for backend changes, and one for frontend changes. Those
branches would then all be stacked onto each other.

Git has support for rebasing such a stack as a whole; you can enable it by
setting the git config `rebase.updateRefs` to true. If you then rebase the
topmost branch of the stack, the other ones in the stack will follow. This
includes interactive rebases, so for example amending a commit in the first
branch of the stack will "just work" in the sense that it keeps the other
branches properly stacked onto it.

Lazygit visualizes the individual branch heads in the stack by marking them with a
cyan asterisk (or a cyan branch symbol if you are using [nerd
fonts](Config.md#display-nerd-fonts-icons)).

content.text: The program is a Git terminal UI with both command-line utilities and interactive workflows. I’ll first pin down its CLI behavior, then use an isolated repository in tmux to observe the screen layout, dialogs, and Git operations without disturbing the workspace.

output.arguments:
{"command":"pwd; python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
for a in [['--blah'],['--path'],['--screen-mode','bad'],['nonsense'],['status','extra'],['--version=foo'],['--path=/none']]:
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(['./executable']+a,capture_output=True,timeout=2)
  err=p.stderr.decode(); start=err.find('  Flags:')
  if '  Usage:' in err:
   pos=err.find('\n\n',err.find('The initial screen-mode'))
   err='<HELP>'+err[pos+2:]
  print(a,p.returncode,repr(p.stdout.decode()),repr(err))
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e: print(a,'TIMEOUT',repr(e.stdout),repr(e.stderr))
PY
mkdir -p /tmp/lg-observe/repo /tmp/lg-observe/config
cd /tmp/lg-observe/repo && git init -q && git config user.name 'Test User' && git config user.email 'test@example.com' && printf 'hello\nworld\n' > hello.txt && mkdir -p src && printf 'one\ntwo\nthree\n' > src/main.txt && git add . && git commit -qm 'Initial commit' && printf 'hello\nworld changed\nnew line\n' > hello.txt && printf 'untracked content\n' > new.txt
ROOT=$(git -C /tmp/lg-observe/repo rev-parse --show-toplevel); cd - >/dev/null
EXE="$PWD/executable"; tmux -L lg-test new-session -d -s ref -x 120 -y 40 "cd /tmp/lg-observe/repo && $EXE --use-config-dir /tmp/lg-observe/config; echo EXIT:\$?; sleep 600"
sleep 1; tmux -L lg-test capture-pane -p -t ref"}

class App(Actions):
    def __init__(self,path,config,args):
        self.cfg=config;self.args=args
        self.git=Git(path,config)
        self.git.filter_path=args.get('filter','')
        self.focus={'status':2,'branch':3,'log':4,'stash':5}.get(args.get('git-arg'),2)
        if self.git.filter_path:self.focus=4
        self.side_focus=self.focus
        self.tabs={2:0,3:0,4:0}
        self.positions={};self.list_scroll={}
        self.collapsed=set();self.file_filter=''
        self.tree_mode=self.cfg.get('gui.showFileTree',True)
        self.screen_mode=args.get('screen-mode') or self.cfg.get('gui.screenMode','normal')
        if self.screen_mode not in ('normal','half','full'):self.screen_mode='normal'
        self.main_scroll=[0,0];self.main_horizontal=0
        self.stage=False;self.stage_side=0;self.stage_line=0
        self.hunk_mode=self.cfg.get('gui.useHunkModeInStagingView',True)
        self.commit_file_parent=None;self.commit_file_list=[];self.sub_branch=None;self.remote_branch=None
        self.search_text='';self.search_edit=False;self.search_active=False;self.search_context=''
        self.search_cursor=0;self.search_match=0

        self.command_log=["You can hide/focus this panel by pressing '@'",'']
        self.command_log_scroll=0
        self.log_hidden=self.cfg.state.get('hidecommandlog',False) or not self.cfg.get('gui.showCommandLog',True)
        self.log_focus=False;self.toast='';self.toast_until=0
        self.range_start=None;self.copied_commits=[];self.base_commit=None
        self.undo_stack=[];self.redo_stack=[]
        self.suspended=False;self.last_refresh=0;self.needs_refresh=True
        self.main_cache={};self.rects={}
        self.help_data=json.loads(resource('key-help.json'))
        self.refresh()
        recent=self.cfg.state.get('recentrepos') or []
        self.cfg.state['recentrepos']=[self.git.path]+[p for p in recent if p!=self.git.path]
        if self.cfg.get('gui.showRandomTip',True):
            self.command_log.append("Random tip: You can press '?' to see a list of keybindings")
        if not self.cfg.get('disableStartupPopups',False) and self.cfg.state.get('startuppopupversion',0)<5:
            self.welcome()
        self.cfg.state['lastversion']='d8d00105'
        self.cfg.save_state()

    def ctx(self):
        if self.log_focus:return 'commandLog'
        if self.focus==0:return 'staging' if self.stage else 'main'
        if self.focus==1:return 'status'
        if self.focus==2:return ['files','worktrees','submodules'][self.tabs[2]]
        if self.focus==3:
            if self.remote_branch:return 'remoteBranches'
            return ['localBranches','remotes','tags'][self.tabs[3]]
        if self.focus==4:
            if self.commit_file_parent:return 'commitFiles'
            if self.sub_branch:return 'subCommits'
            return ['commits','reflogCommits'][self.tabs[4]]
        return 'stash'

    def side_ctx(self):
        old=self.focus;self.focus=self.side_focus
        c=self.ctx();self.focus=old
        return c

    def refresh(self):
        self.git.refresh();self.last_refresh=time.monotonic();self.needs_refresh=False
        self.file_entries=self.git.tree(self.tree_mode,self.cfg.get('gui.showRootItemInFileTree',True),self.collapsed,self.file_filter)
        if self.commit_file_parent:self.commit_file_list=self.git.commit_files(self.commit_file_parent)
        self.main_cache={}
        for context in list(self.positions):
            count=len(self.items(context))
            self.positions[context]=max(0,min(self.positions[context],count-1))

    def items(self,context=None):
        context=context or self.ctx()
        collection={'files':self.file_entries,'worktrees':self.git.worktrees,'submodules':self.git.submodules,
                    'localBranches':self.git.branches,'remotes':self.git.remotes,'tags':self.git.tags,
                    'commits':self.git.commits,'subCommits':self.git.commits,'reflogCommits':self.git.reflog,
                    'stash':self.git.stashes,'commitFiles':self.commit_file_list}
        values=collection.get(context,[])
        if context=='remoteBranches':
            values=[]
            for l in self.git.text('for-each-ref','--sort=refname','--format=%(refname:short)%00%(objectname)', 'refs/remotes/'+str(self.remote_branch)+'/').splitlines():
                p=l.split('\x00')
                if len(p)>1:values.append({'name':p[0],'hash':p[1]})
        if self.search_text and self.search_context==context and self.is_filter(context):
            q=self.search_text.lower()
            def matches(item):
                s=str(item.get('name','')).lower()
                if self.cfg.get('gui.filterMode')=='fuzzy':
                    it=iter(s);return all(any(x==c for x in it) for c in q)
                return q in s
            values=[v for v in values if matches(v)]
        return values

    def selected(self,context=None):
        c=context or self.ctx();items=self.items(c);p=self.positions.get(c,0)
        return items[max(0,min(p,len(items)-1))] if items else None

    def set_focus(self,number):
        if number!=0:self.side_focus=number;self.stage=False
        self.focus=number;self.log_focus=False
        self.main_scroll=[0,0];self.main_cache={};self.range_start=None

    def notify(self,text):
        self.toast=text;self.toast_until=time.monotonic()+4

    def error(self,text,title='Error'):
        self.popup=Popup('message',title,text.strip() or 'An error occurred')

    def confirm(self,title,text,callback):
        self.popup=Popup('confirm',title,text,callback)

    def prompt(self,title,callback,initial='',suggestions=None):
        self.popup=Popup('input',title,initial,callback,cursor=len(initial),suggestions=suggestions)

    def menu(self,title,options,header=''):
        # An option contains its shortcut, label, callback, help text, and disabled reason.
        normalized=[]
        for option in options:
            normalized.append(tuple(option)+('',)*(5-len(option)))
        self.popup=Popup('menu',title,options=normalized,header=header)

    def list_title(self,number):
        if number==1:return 'Status'
        if number==2:
            names=['Files','Worktrees','Submodules'];active=self.tabs[2]
        elif number==3:
            if self.remote_branch:return 'Remote branches ('+self.remote_branch+')'
            names=['Local branches','Remotes','Tags'];active=self.tabs[3]
        elif number==4:
            if self.commit_file_parent:
                p=self.commit_file_parent;return 'Diff files ('+p['hash'][:7]+' '+p.get('message',p.get('name',''))+')'
            if self.sub_branch:return 'Commits ('+self.sub_branch+')'
            names=['Commits','Reflog'];active=self.tabs[4]
        else:return 'Stash'
        return ' - '.join('\x1b[32m'+x+'\x1b[39m' if i==active else x for i,x in enumerate(names))

    def number_context(self,n):
        f=self.focus;self.focus=n;c=self.ctx();self.focus=f;return c

    def layout(self,w,h):
        available=h-(1 if self.cfg.get('gui.showBottomLine',True) or self.search_active or self.search_edit else 0)
        available=max(2,available)
        mode=self.screen_mode;focus=self.side_focus if self.focus==0 or self.log_focus else self.focus
        sw=max(2,min(w-2,math.ceil(w*float(self.cfg.get('gui.sidePanelWidth',.3333)))))
        out={}
        if mode=='full':
            if self.focus==0 or self.log_focus:
                out['main']=(0,0,w,available)
            else:out[focus]=(0,0,w,available)
            return out
        if mode=='half':
            if self.cfg.get('gui.enlargedSideViewLocation')=='top':
                sh=math.ceil(available/2)
                out[focus]=(0,0,w,sh);out['main']=(0,sh,w,available-sh)
            else:
                sw=math.ceil(w/2);out[focus]=(0,0,sw,available);out['main']=(sw,0,w-sw,available)
        else:
            out[1]=(0,0,sw,3)
            if h<30:
                heights={2:3,3:3,4:3,5:3}
                heights[focus if focus in heights else 2]=max(3,available-12)
            else:
                expanded=[2,3,4,5] if focus==5 else [2,3,4]
                total=available-3-(0 if focus==5 else 3)
                heights={5:3}
                weighted=self.cfg.get('gui.expandFocusedSidePanel',False)
                weights=[float(self.cfg.get('gui.expandedSidePanelWeight',2)) if weighted and f==focus else 1 for f in expanded]
                rest=total;remaining=sum(weights)
                for f,wt in zip(expanded,weights):
                    height=math.ceil(rest*wt/remaining) if remaining else 0
                    heights[f]=height;rest-=height;remaining-=wt
            y=3
            for number in (2,3,4,5):
                hh=heights[number];out[number]=(0,y,sw,hh);y+=hh
            out['main']=(sw,0,w-sw,available)
        if 'main' in out and not self.log_hidden:
            x,y,mw,mh=out['main'];lh=min(mh-4,int(self.cfg.get('gui.commandLogSize',8))+2 if h>=40 else 3)
            if lh>=3:
                out['log']=(x,y+mh-lh,mw,lh);out['main']=(x,y,mw,mh-lh)
        return out

    def row_text(self,context,item,panel_width):
        if context=='files' or context=='commitFiles':
            prefix='  '*item.get('depth',0)
            if item.get('directory'):
                col='32' if item.get('staged') else '31'
                return prefix+'\x1b['+col+'m'+('▶' if item['collapsed'] else '▼')+' '+item.get('label',item['name'])+'\x1b[39m'
            code=item.get('status','  ')
            name=item.get('label',item['name'])
            if context=='commitFiles':return '\x1b[32m'+code[0]+' '+name+'\x1b[39m'
            c0='32' if item.get('staged') else '31'
            c1='31' if item.get('unstaged') else '32'
            pathcol='31' if item.get('unstaged') else '32'
            return prefix+'\x1b['+c0+'m'+code[0]+'\x1b['+c1+'m'+code[1]+' \x1b['+pathcol+'m'+name+'\x1b[39m'
        if context in ('localBranches','remoteBranches'):
            ages=[short_age(b.get('stamp',0)) for b in self.items(context) if b.get('current')!='*' and b.get('stamp')]
            sz=max([3]+[len(a) for a in ages])
            if item.get('current')=='*':pre='*'.rjust(sz)
            else:pre=short_age(item['stamp']).rjust(sz) if item.get('stamp') else ''
            name=item['name']
            if context=='remoteBranches' and self.remote_branch:name=name.removeprefix(self.remote_branch+'/')
            col='32' if item.get('current')=='*' else '37'
            text='\x1b[34m'+pre+' \x1b['+col+'m'+name+'\x1b[39m'
            if self.cfg.get('gui.showBranchCommitHash'):text+=' '+item['hash'][:self.cfg.get('gui.commitHashLength',8)]
            if item.get('track'):text+=' '+item['track'].replace('ahead ','↑').replace('behind ','↓').strip('[]').replace(',','')
            return text
        if context in ('commits','subCommits','reflogCommits'):
            n=self.cfg.get('gui.commitHashLength',8)
            author=item.get('author','')
            hashstr=item['hash'][:n]
            pre='\x1b[32m'+hashstr+'\x1b[39m '
            if context=='reflogCommits':
                pre+='\x1b[34m'+short_age(item.get('stamp',0)).rjust(3)+'\x1b[39m '
            if panel_width>80:
                pre+='\x1b[34m'+short_age(item.get('stamp',0)).rjust(3)+'\x1b[39m '
                size=self.cfg.get('gui.commitAuthorLongLength',17)
                pre+='\x1b[33m'+truncate(author,size).ljust(size)+'\x1b[39m '
            else:
                size=self.cfg.get('gui.commitAuthorShortLength',2)
                pre+='\x1b[33m'+initials(author,size)+'\x1b[39m '
            if context!='reflogCommits' and self.cfg.get('git.log.showGraph','always')!='never':pre+='\x1b[37m'+item.get('graph','◯')+'\x1b[39m '
            refs=item.get('refs','');tags=re.findall(r'tag: ([^,]+)',refs)
            if tags:pre+='\x1b[33m'+' '.join(tags)+'\x1b[39m '
            return pre+item.get('message','')
        if context=='stash':
            return '\x1b[34m'+short_age(item['stamp'])+'\x1b[39m '+item['name']
        if context=='remotes':return item['name']+' '+item['url']
        if context=='tags':return '\x1b[34m'+short_age(item.get('stamp',0))+'\x1b[39m '+item['name']
        if context=='worktrees':
            flag='* ' if os.path.realpath(item['path'])==os.path.realpath(self.git.path) else '  '
            return flag+item['name']+' → '+item.get('branch','')
        if context=='submodules':return item['name']
        return item.get('name','')

    def draw_list(self,cv,number,rect):
        x,y,w,h=rect
        current=self.focus==number and not self.log_focus and not self.popup
        bs=self.active_border if current else self.inactive_border
        if current and (self.search_active or self.search_edit):bs=color(self.cfg.get('gui.theme.searchingActiveBorderColor',['cyan','bold']))
        title=self.list_title(number)
        if self.cfg.get('gui.showPanelJumps',True):title='['+str(number)+']─'+title
        context=self.number_context(number)
        values=self.items(context)
        p=self.positions.get(context,0)
        p=max(0,min(p,len(values)-1));self.positions[context]=p
        footer=str(p+1 if values else 0)+' of '+str(len(values)) if self.cfg.get('gui.showListFooter',True) and number!=1 else ''
        vh=h-2
        scroll=self.list_scroll.get(context,0)
        if p<scroll:scroll=p
        if p>=scroll+vh:scroll=max(0,p-vh+1)
        scroll=max(0,min(scroll,max(0,len(values)-vh)))
        self.list_scroll[context]=scroll
        bar=None
        if len(values)>vh and vh>0:
            size=max(1,math.ceil(vh*vh/len(values)));start=int(scroll*(vh-size)/max(1,len(values)-vh));bar=(start,size)
        cv.box(x,y,w,h,title,bs,self.border,footer,bar)
        if number==1:
            text=os.path.basename(self.git.path.rstrip('/'))+' → '+self.git.branch
            if self.git.upstream:text+=' ↑'+str(self.git.ahead)+' ↓'+str(self.git.behind)
            cv.put(x+1,y+1,text,'0',w-2)
            return
        for row,item in enumerate(values[scroll:scroll+max(0,vh)]):
            index=scroll+row
            style='0'
            inrange=self.range_start is not None and context==self.ctx() and min(self.range_start,p)<=index<=max(self.range_start,p)
            if index==p or inrange:
                style=self.selected_style if current else '1'
                cv.fill(x+1,y+1+row,w-2,1,style)
            if item.get('hash') in self.copied_commits:style='34;46';cv.fill(x+1,y+1+row,w-2,1,style)
            text=self.row_text(context,item,w)
            cv.put(x+1,y+1+row,text,style,w-2)

    def main_data(self):
        context=self.side_ctx() if self.focus==0 else self.ctx()
        if self.log_focus:context=self.side_ctx()
        item=self.selected(context)
        key=(context,str(item),self.stage,str(self.cfg.get('git.diffContextSize')),self.git.head,self.file_filter)
        if key in self.main_cache:return self.main_cache[key]
        views=[]
        if context=='files':
            if not item:views=[('Diff','No changed files',False)]
            else:
                both=(item.get('staged') and item.get('unstaged')) or self.stage or self.cfg.get('gui.splitDiff')=='always'
                if both or item.get('unstaged'):
                    views.append(('Unstaged changes',self.git.diff(item,False),True))
                if both or not item.get('unstaged'):
                    views.append(('Staged changes',self.git.diff(item,True),True))
        elif context in ('commits','subCommits','reflogCommits'):
            views=[('Patch',self.git.show_commit(item) if item else 'No commits',bool(item))]
        elif context=='commitFiles':
            views=[('Patch',self.git.show_commit(self.commit_file_parent,item['name']) if item else 'No files',bool(item))]
        elif context in ('localBranches','remoteBranches','tags'):
            views=[('Log',self.git.branch_log(item['name']) if item else ('No tags' if context=='tags' else 'No branches'),bool(item))]
        elif context=='remotes':
            if item:
                text='Fetch URL: '+item['url']+'\nPush URL: '+self.git.text('remote','get-url','--push',item['name'])
            else:text='No remotes'
            views=[('Remote',text,False)]
        elif context=='stash':views=[('Stash',self.git.stash_diff(item) if item else 'No stash entries',bool(item))]
        elif context=='worktrees':views=[('Worktree',item['path'] if item else 'No worktrees',False)]
        elif context=='submodules':views=[('Submodule',item['name'] if item else 'No submodules',False)]
        elif context=='status':
            if self.cfg.get('gui.statusPanelView')=='allBranchesLog':views=[('Log',self.git.branch_log('--all'),True)]
            else:views=[('Status',self.dashboard(),True)]
        else:views=[('Diff','',False)]
        self.main_cache[key]=views
        return views

    def draw_main(self,cv,rect):
        data=self.main_data();x,y,w,h=rect
        locations=[rect]
        if len(data)>1:
            split=self.cfg.get('gui.mainPanelSplitMode','flexible')
            vertical=split=='vertical' or (split=='flexible' and w>=160)
            if vertical:
                s=math.ceil(w/2);locations=[(x,y,s,h),(x+s,y,w-s,h)]
            else:
                s=math.ceil(h/2);locations=[(x,y,w,s),(x,y+s,w,h-s)]
        self.main_rects=locations
        for i,(title,text,scrollable) in enumerate(data):
            rx,ry,rw,rh=locations[min(i,len(locations)-1)]
            active=self.focus==0 and not self.popup and not self.log_focus and (not self.stage or i==self.stage_side)
            bs=self.active_border if active else self.inactive_border
            if not self.stage and i==0 and self.cfg.get('gui.showPanelJumps',True):title='[0]─'+title
            text=text.replace('\r','').expandtabs(int(self.cfg.get('gui.tabWidth',4)))
            lines=text.splitlines()
            if not lines:lines=['']
            viewheight=max(0,rh-2);offset=self.main_scroll[i]
            if not self.cfg.get('gui.scrollPastBottom',True):offset=min(offset,max(0,len(lines)-viewheight));self.main_scroll[i]=offset
            bar=None
            if scrollable and text and viewheight>0:
                total=len(lines)+viewheight if self.cfg.get('gui.scrollPastBottom',True) else max(len(lines),viewheight)
                length=max(1,min(viewheight,math.ceil(viewheight*viewheight/max(1,total))))
                start=int(min(offset,max(0,total-viewheight))*(viewheight-length)/max(1,total-viewheight))
                bar=(start,length)
            cv.box(rx,ry,rw,rh,title,bs,self.border,scroll=bar)
            hunk_start=-1;hunk_end=-1
            if self.stage and i==self.stage_side:
                headers=[j for j,l in enumerate(lines) if strip_ansi(l).startswith('@@')]
                for j in headers:
                    if j<=self.stage_line:hunk_start=j
                if hunk_start<0 and headers:hunk_start=headers[0];self.stage_line=hunk_start
                hunk_end=next((j for j in headers if j>hunk_start),len(lines))
            for r,line in enumerate(lines[offset:offset+viewheight]):
                style='0';idx=offset+r
                if self.stage and i==self.stage_side and not self.popup:
                    selected=(hunk_start<=idx<hunk_end) if self.hunk_mode else idx==self.stage_line
                    if selected:style=self.selected_style;cv.fill(rx+1,ry+1+r,rw-2,1,style)
                if self.main_horizontal:
                    line=strip_ansi(line)[self.main_horizontal:]
                cv.put(rx+1,ry+1+r,line,style,rw-2)

    def draw_log(self,cv,rect):
        x,y,w,h=rect;vh=max(1,h-2)
        text=[]
        for l in self.command_log:
            text.extend(wrap(l,w-2) if self.log_focus else [l])
        top=max(0,len(text)-vh-self.command_log_scroll)
        bar=None
        if len(text)>vh:
            length=max(1,math.ceil(vh*vh/len(text)));start=math.floor(top*(vh-length)/max(1,len(text)-vh));bar=(start,length)
        cv.box(x,y,w,h,'Command log',self.active_border if self.log_focus and not self.popup else self.inactive_border,self.border,scroll=bar)
        for i,l in enumerate(text[top:top+vh]):
            style='34' if l.startswith('  git ') else '0'
            cv.put(x+1,y+1+i,l,style,w-2)

    def help_line(self):
        if self.popup:
            if self.popup.kind=='commit':return ''
            if self.popup.kind=='menu':return 'Execute: <enter> | Close/Cancel: <esc>'
            if self.popup.kind=='input':return 'Confirm: <enter> | Close/Cancel: <esc>'
            return 'Confirm: <enter> | Close/Cancel: <esc> | Copy to clipboard: <c-o>'
        c=self.ctx()
        if c=='files':
            if not self.file_entries:return 'Commit: c | Stash: s | Reset: D | Keybindings: ?'
            return 'Stage: <space> | Commit: c | Stash: s | Discard: d | Reset: D | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='localBranches':return 'Checkout: <space> | New branch: n | Delete: d | Rebase: r | Reset: g | Upstream: u | Keybindings: ?'

                size=self.cfg.get('gui.commitAuthorShortLength',2)
                pre+='\x1b[33m'+initials(author,size)+'\x1b[39m '
            if context!='reflogCommits' and self.cfg.get('git.log.showGraph','always')!='never':pre+='\x1b[37m'+item.get('graph','◯')+'\x1b[39m '
            refs=item.get('refs','');tags=re.findall(r'tag: ([^,]+)',refs)
            if tags:pre+='\x1b[33m'+' '.join(tags)+'\x1b[39m '
            return pre+item.get('message','')
        if context=='stash':
            return '\x1b[34m'+short_age(item['stamp'])+'\x1b[39m '+item['name']
        if context=='remotes':return item['name']+' '+item['url']
        if context=='tags':return '\x1b[34m'+short_age(item.get('stamp',0))+'\x1b[39m '+item['name']
        if context=='worktrees':
            flag='* ' if os.path.realpath(item['path'])==os.path.realpath(self.git.path) else '  '
            return flag+item['name']+' → '+item.get('branch','')
        if context=='submodules':return item['name']
        return item.get('name','')

    def draw_list(self,cv,number,rect):
        x,y,w,h=rect
        current=self.focus==number and not self.log_focus and not self.popup
        bs=self.active_border if current else self.inactive_border
        if current and (self.search_active or self.search_edit):bs=color(self.cfg.get('gui.theme.searchingActiveBorderColor',['cyan','bold']))
        title=self.list_title(number)
        if self.cfg.get('gui.showPanelJumps',True):title='['+str(number)+']─'+title
        context=self.number_context(number)
        values=self.items(context)
        p=self.positions.get(context,0)
        p=max(0,min(p,len(values)-1));self.positions[context]=p
        footer=str(p+1 if values else 0)+' of '+str(len(values)) if self.cfg.get('gui.showListFooter',True) and number!=1 else ''
        vh=h-2
        scroll=self.list_scroll.get(context,0)
        if p<scroll:scroll=p
        if p>=scroll+vh:scroll=max(0,p-vh+1)
        scroll=max(0,min(scroll,max(0,len(values)-vh)))
        self.list_scroll[context]=scroll
        bar=None
        if len(values)>vh and vh>0:
            size=max(1,math.ceil(vh*vh/len(values)));start=int(scroll*(vh-size)/max(1,len(values)-vh));bar=(start,size)
        cv.box(x,y,w,h,title,bs,self.border,footer,bar)
        if number==1:
            text=os.path.basename(self.git.path.rstrip('/'))+' → '+self.git.branch
            if self.git.upstream:text+=' ↑'+str(self.git.ahead)+' ↓'+str(self.git.behind)
            cv.put(x+1,y+1,text,'0',w-2)
            return
        for row,item in enumerate(values[scroll:scroll+max(0,vh)]):
            index=scroll+row
            style='0'
            inrange=self.range_start is not None and context==self.ctx() and min(self.range_start,p)<=index<=max(self.range_start,p)
            if index==p or inrange:
                style=self.selected_style if current else '1'
                cv.fill(x+1,y+1+row,w-2,1,style)
            if item.get('hash') in self.copied_commits:style='34;46';cv.fill(x+1,y+1+row,w-2,1,style)
            text=self.row_text(context,item,w)
            cv.put(x+1,y+1+row,text,style,w-2)

    def main_data(self):
        context=self.side_ctx() if self.focus==0 else self.ctx()
        if self.log_focus:context=self.side_ctx()
        item=self.selected(context)
        key=(context,str(item),self.stage,str(self.cfg.get('git.diffContextSize')),self.git.head,self.file_filter)
        if key in self.main_cache:return self.main_cache[key]
        views=[]
        if context=='files':
            if not item:views=[('Diff','No changed files',False)]
            else:
                both=(item.get('staged') and item.get('unstaged')) or self.stage or self.cfg.get('gui.splitDiff')=='always'
                if both or item.get('unstaged'):
                    views.append(('Unstaged changes',self.git.diff(item,False),True))
                if both or not item.get('unstaged'):
                    views.append(('Staged changes',self.git.diff(item,True),True))
        elif context in ('commits','subCommits','reflogCommits'):
            views=[('Patch',self.git.show_commit(item) if item else 'No commits',bool(item))]
        elif context=='commitFiles':
            views=[('Patch',self.git.show_commit(self.commit_file_parent,item['name']) if item else 'No files',bool(item))]
        elif context in ('localBranches','remoteBranches','tags'):
            views=[('Log',self.git.branch_log(item['name']) if item else ('No tags' if context=='tags' else 'No branches'),bool(item))]
        elif context=='remotes':
            if item:
                text='Fetch URL: '+item['url']+'\nPush URL: '+self.git.text('remote','get-url','--push',item['name'])
            else:text='No remotes'
            views=[('Remote',text,False)]
        elif context=='stash':views=[('Stash',self.git.stash_diff(item) if item else 'No stash entries',bool(item))]
        elif context=='worktrees':views=[('Worktree',item['path'] if item else 'No worktrees',False)]
        elif context=='submodules':views=[('Submodule',item['name'] if item else 'No submodules',False)]
        elif context=='status':
            if self.cfg.get('gui.statusPanelView')=='allBranchesLog':views=[('Log',self.git.branch_log('--all'),True)]
            else:views=[('Status',self.dashboard(),True)]
        else:views=[('Diff','',False)]
        self.main_cache[key]=views
        return views

    def dashboard(self):
        return ("\n   _                       _ _\n  | |                     (_) |\n"
                "  | | __ _ _____   _  __ _ _| |_\n  | |/ _` |_  / | | |/ _` | | __|\n"

    def draw_main(self,cv,rect):
        data=self.main_data();x,y,w,h=rect
        locations=[rect]
        if len(data)>1:
            split=self.cfg.get('gui.mainPanelSplitMode','flexible')
            vertical=split=='vertical' or (split=='flexible' and w>=160)
            if vertical:
                s=math.ceil(w/2);locations=[(x,y,s,h),(x+s,y,w-s,h)]
            else:
                s=math.ceil(h/2);locations=[(x,y,w,s),(x,y+s,w,h-s)]
        self.main_rects=locations
        for i,(title,text,scrollable) in enumerate(data):
            rx,ry,rw,rh=locations[min(i,len(locations)-1)]
            active=self.focus==0 and not self.popup and not self.log_focus and (not self.stage or i==self.stage_side)
            bs=self.active_border if active else self.inactive_border
            if not self.stage and i==0 and self.cfg.get('gui.showPanelJumps',True):title='[0]─'+title
            text=text.replace('\r','').expandtabs(int(self.cfg.get('gui.tabWidth',4)))
            lines=text.splitlines()
            if not lines:lines=['']
            viewheight=max(0,rh-2);offset=self.main_scroll[i]
            if not self.cfg.get('gui.scrollPastBottom',True):offset=min(offset,max(0,len(lines)-viewheight));self.main_scroll[i]=offset
            bar=None
            if scrollable and text and viewheight>0:
                total=len(lines)+viewheight if self.cfg.get('gui.scrollPastBottom',True) else max(len(lines),viewheight)
                length=max(1,min(viewheight,math.ceil(viewheight*viewheight/max(1,total))))
                start=int(min(offset,max(0,total-viewheight))*(viewheight-length)/max(1,total-viewheight))
                bar=(start,length)
            cv.box(rx,ry,rw,rh,title,bs,self.border,scroll=bar)
            hunk_start=-1;hunk_end=-1
            if self.stage and i==self.stage_side:
                headers=[j for j,l in enumerate(lines) if strip_ansi(l).startswith('@@')]
                for j in headers:
                    if j<=self.stage_line:hunk_start=j
                if hunk_start<0 and headers:hunk_start=headers[0];self.stage_line=hunk_start
                hunk_end=next((j for j in headers if j>hunk_start),len(lines))
            for r,line in enumerate(lines[offset:offset+viewheight]):
                style='0';idx=offset+r
                if self.stage and i==self.stage_side and not self.popup:
                    selected=(hunk_start<=idx<hunk_end) if self.hunk_mode else idx==self.stage_line
                    if selected:style=self.selected_style;cv.fill(rx+1,ry+1+r,rw-2,1,style)
                if self.main_horizontal:
                    line=strip_ansi(line)[self.main_horizontal:]
                cv.put(rx+1,ry+1+r,line,style,rw-2)

    def draw_log(self,cv,rect):
        x,y,w,h=rect;vh=max(1,h-2)
        text=[]
        for l in self.command_log:
            text.extend(wrap(l,w-2) if self.log_focus else [l])
        top=max(0,len(text)-vh-self.command_log_scroll)
        bar=None
        if len(text)>vh:
            length=max(1,math.ceil(vh*vh/len(text)));start=math.floor(top*(vh-length)/max(1,len(text)-vh));bar=(start,length)
        cv.box(x,y,w,h,'Command log',self.active_border if self.log_focus and not self.popup else self.inactive_border,self.border,scroll=bar)
        for i,l in enumerate(text[top:top+vh]):
            style='34' if l.startswith('  git ') else '0'
            cv.put(x+1,y+1+i,l,style,w-2)

    def help_line(self):
        if self.popup:
            if self.popup.kind=='commit':return ''
            if self.popup.kind=='menu':return 'Execute: <enter> | Close/Cancel: <esc>'
            if self.popup.kind=='input':return 'Confirm: <enter> | Close/Cancel: <esc>'
            return 'Confirm: <enter> | Close/Cancel: <esc> | Copy to clipboard: <c-o>'
        c=self.ctx()
        if c=='files':
            if not self.file_entries:return 'Commit: c | Stash: s | Reset: D | Keybindings: ?'
            return 'Stage: <space> | Commit: c | Stash: s | Discard: d | Reset: D | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='localBranches':return 'Checkout: <space> | New branch: n | Delete: d | Rebase: r | Reset: g | Upstream: u | Keybindings: ?'
        if c in ('commits','subCommits'):return 'Reword: r | Drop: d | Edit: e | Amend: A | Checkout: <space> | Reset: g | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='stash':return 'Apply: <space> | Pop: g | Drop: d | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='status':return 'Edit config file: e | Check for update: u | Switch to a recent repo: <enter> | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='commitFiles':return 'Checkout: c | Remove: d | Edit: e | Toggle file included in patch: <space> | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='remotes':return 'New remote: n | Remove: d | Edit: e | Fetch: f | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='tags':return 'Checkout: <space> | New tag: n | Delete: d | Push: P | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='worktrees':return 'Switch worktree: <enter> | New worktree: n | Remove: d | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='staging':return 'Stage selected hunk: <space> | Stage whole file: a | Discard: d | Toggle hunk/line: a | Return: <esc> | Keybindings: ?'
        if c=='reflogCommits':return 'Checkout: <space> | Reset: g | Copy (cherry-pick): C | Keybindings: ?'
        return 'Keybindings: ? | Return: <esc>'

    def is_filter(self,c):
        return c in ('localBranches','remoteBranches','remotes','tags','worktrees','submodules','stash')

    def search_matches(self):
        values=self.items(self.search_context)
        return [i for i,v in enumerate(values) if self.search_text.lower() in strip_ansi(self.row_text(self.search_context,v,120)).lower()]

    def draw_bottom(self,cv):
        y=cv.h-1
        if self.search_edit:
            prefix='Filter: ' if self.is_filter(self.search_context) else 'Search: '
            cv.put(0,y,prefix+self.search_text,'0',cv.w);cv.cursor=(min(cv.w-1,len(prefix)+self.search_cursor),y);return
        if self.search_active:
            if self.is_filter(self.search_context):text="Filter: '"+self.search_text+"' (<esc>: Exit filter mode)"
            else:
                matches=self.search_matches();index=min(self.search_match+1,len(matches))
                text="Search: matches for '"+self.search_text+"' ("+str(index)+' of '+str(len(matches))+') n: Next match, N: Previous match, <esc>: Exit search mode'
            cv.put(0,y,text,'0',cv.w);return
        if not self.cfg.get('gui.showBottomLine',True):return
        buttons='Donate Ask Question d8d00105'
        start=cv.w-len(buttons)
        if start>=0:cv.put(start,y,buttons,'0')
        available=max(0,start-4)
        text=self.help_line()
        if self.toast and time.monotonic()<self.toast_until:text=self.toast+' '+text
        if width(text)>available:
            parts=text.split(' | ');result=[]
            for part in parts:
                trial=' | '.join(result+[part])
                if width(trial)+4>available:break
                result.append(part)
            text=' | '.join(result)+(' | …' if result else '…')
        cv.put(0,y,text,'34',available)

    def draw_popup(self,cv):
        p=self.popup
        if not p:return
        nominal=min(80,cv.w-2);x=(cv.w-nominal)//2;pw=nominal+1;bw=pw-2
        border=self.active_border
        if p.kind=='menu':
            header=wrap(p.header,bw) if p.header else []
            if header:header+=['']
            maxcount=max(1,int(cv.h*.75)-3-len(header))
            count=min(len(p.options),maxcount)
            ph=count+2+len(header)
            y=max(0,(cv.h-count-len(header)-5)//2)
            if p.selected<p.scroll:p.scroll=p.selected
            if p.selected>=p.scroll+count:p.scroll=p.selected-count+1
            bar=None
            if len(p.options)>count:
                ln=max(1,math.ceil(count*count/len(p.options)));bar=(int(p.scroll*(count-ln)/max(1,len(p.options)-count)),ln)
            cv.box(x,y,pw,ph,p.title,border,self.border,str(p.selected+1)+' of '+str(len(p.options)),bar)
            for i,l in enumerate(header):cv.put(x+1,y+1+i,l,'0',bw)
            keywidth=max([0]+[len(o[0]) for o in p.options]);has_keys=keywidth>0
            for i,opt in enumerate(p.options[p.scroll:p.scroll+count]):
                key,label,cb,info,disabled=opt
                row=y+1+len(header)+i
                style=self.selected_style if p.scroll+i==p.selected else '0'
                cv.fill(x+1,row,bw,1,style)
                text=key.rjust(keywidth)+' '+label if has_keys else label
                cv.put(x+1,row,text,style,bw)
            if p.options:
                opt=p.options[p.selected];info=opt[3]
                if opt[4]:info=(info+'\n\n' if info else '')+'Disabled: '+opt[4]
                if info:
                    lines=wrap(info,bw);dy=y+ph;dh=min(len(lines)+2,cv.h-1-dy)
                    if dh>=3:
                        cv.box(x,dy,pw,dh,'',self.inactive_border,self.border)
                        for i,l in enumerate(lines[:dh-2]):cv.put(x+1,dy+1+i,l,'0',bw)
            return
        if p.kind=='commit':
            y=max(0,cv.h//2-5)
            title=p.title or 'Commit summary'
            cv.box(x,y,pw,3,title,border if not p.desc_focus else self.inactive_border,self.border)
            if self.cfg.get('gui.commitLength.show',True):
                count=' '+str(len(p.text))+' ';cv.put(x+pw-7-len(count),y,count,border)
            self.draw_editor_line(cv,x+1,y+1,bw,p.text,p.cursor,not p.desc_focus)
            dy=y+3;dh=min(9,cv.h-1-dy)
            hint='Press <tab> to toggle focus, <c-o> to open menu'
            cv.box(x,dy,pw,dh,'Commit description',border if p.desc_focus else self.inactive_border,self.border)
            cv.put(x+max(2,pw-len(hint)-2),dy,hint,self.inactive_border,min(len(hint),pw-4))
            lines=p.description.split('\n')
            for i,l in enumerate(lines[:dh-2]):cv.put(x+1,dy+1+i,l,'0',bw)
            if p.desc_focus:
                before=p.description[:p.desc_cursor];row=before.count('\n');col=len(before.split('\n')[-1]);cv.cursor=(min(x+pw-2,x+1+col),min(dy+dh-2,dy+1+row))
            return
        if p.kind=='input':
            y=max(0,(cv.h-3)//2)
            if p.suggestions is not None:y=max(0,(cv.h-15)//2)
            cv.box(x,y,pw,3,p.title,border,self.border)
            self.draw_editor_line(cv,x+1,y+1,bw,p.text,p.cursor,True)
            if p.suggestions is not None:
                dy=y+3;dh=min(12,cv.h-1-dy)
                values=[str(v) for v in p.suggestions if p.text.lower() in str(v).lower()]
                cv.box(x,dy,pw,dh,'Suggestions (press <tab> to focus)',self.inactive_border,self.border,('1' if values else '0')+' of '+str(len(values)))
                for i,v in enumerate(values[:dh-2]):cv.put(x+1,dy+1+i,v,'0',bw)
            return
        lines=wrap(p.text,bw);ph=min(len(lines)+2,cv.h-2);y=max(0,(cv.h-ph)//2)
        cv.box(x,y,pw,ph,p.title,border,self.border)
        for i,l in enumerate(lines[p.scroll:p.scroll+ph-2]):cv.put(x+1,y+1+i,l,'0',bw)

    def draw_editor_line(self,cv,x,y,w,text,cursor,focused):
        start=max(0,cursor-w+1)
        cv.put(x,y,text[start:],'0',w)
        if focused:cv.cursor=(min(x+w-1,x+cursor-start),y)

    def render(self):
        w,h=self.term.size();cv=Canvas(w,h)
        self.border=self.cfg.get('gui.border','rounded')
        self.active_border=color(self.cfg.get('gui.theme.activeBorderColor',['green','bold']))
        self.inactive_border=color(self.cfg.get('gui.theme.inactiveBorderColor',['default']))
        bg=self.cfg.get('gui.theme.selectedLineBgColor',['blue'])
        bgcode=color(bg,'34')
        for f,b in [('30','40'),('31','41'),('32','42'),('33','43'),('34','44'),('35','45'),('36','46'),('37','47')]:
            if bgcode==f:bgcode=b;break
        if bgcode.startswith('38;'):bgcode='48;'+bgcode[3:]
        self.selected_style=bgcode
        if w<10 or h<10:
            cv.put(0,0,'Terminal is too small','0',w);self.term.draw(cv);return
        self.rects=self.layout(w,h)
        for number in (1,2,3,4,5):
            if number in self.rects:self.draw_list(cv,number,self.rects[number])
        if 'main' in self.rects:self.draw_main(cv,self.rects['main'])
        if 'log' in self.rects:self.draw_log(cv,self.rects['log'])
        self.draw_bottom(cv);self.draw_popup(cv)
        self.term.draw(cv)

    def quit(self,without_cd=False):
        if self.cfg.get('confirmOnQuit',False) and not without_cd:
            self.confirm('Quit','Are you sure you want to quit?',lambda:self.finish_quit(False));return
        self.finish_quit(without_cd)

    def finish_quit(self,without_cd=False):
        self.exit_no_cd=without_cd;self.running=False

    def run(self):
        self.term=Terminal(self.cfg.get('gui.mouseEvents',True))
        def stop_signal(*unused):self.running=False
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop_signal)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop_signal)
        try:
            self.term.start()
            while self.running and not self.term.closed:
                interval=max(1,float(self.cfg.get('refresher.refreshInterval',10)))
                if self.needs_refresh or (self.cfg.get('git.autoRefresh',True) and time.monotonic()-self.last_refresh>=interval):self.refresh()
                self.render()
                for key in self.term.keys(.15):
                    self.handle_key(key)
                    if not self.running:break
        finally:
            self.term.stop()
            self.cfg.state['hidecommandlog']=self.log_hidden
            self.cfg.save_state()
            if not self.exit_no_cd and os.environ.get('LAZYGIT_NEW_DIR_FILE'):
                try:Path(os.environ['LAZYGIT_NEW_DIR_FILE']).write_text(self.git.path)
                except OSError:pass
        return 0

## Predefined commit message prefix

In situations where certain naming pattern is used for branches and commits, pattern can be used to populate commit message with prefix that is parsed from the branch name.
If you define multiple naming patterns, they will be attempted in order until one matches.

Example hitting first match:

- Branch name: feature/AB-123
- Generated commit message prefix: [AB-123]

Example hitting second match:

- Branch name: CD-456_fix_problem
- Generated commit message prefix: (CD-456)

```yaml
git:
  commitPrefix:
    - pattern: "^\\w+\\/(\\w+-\\w+).*"
      replace: '[$1] '
    - pattern: "^([^_]+)_.*" # Take all text prior to the first underscore
      replace: '($1) '
```

If you want repository-specific prefixes, you can map them with `commitPrefixes`. If you have both entries in `commitPrefix` defined and an repository match in `commitPrefixes` for the current repo, the `commitPrefixes` entries will be attempted first. Repository folder names must be an exact match.

```yaml
git:
  commitPrefixes:
    my_project: # This is repository folder name
      - pattern: "^\\w+\\/(\\w+-\\w+).*"
        replace: '[$1] '
  commitPrefix:
      - pattern: "^(\\w+)-.*" # A more general match for any leading word
        replace : '[$1] '
      - pattern: ".*" # The final fallthrough regex that copies over the whole branch name
        replace : '[$0] '
```

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The way golang regex works is when you use `$n` in the replacement string, where `n` is a number, it puts the nth captured subgroup at that place. If `n` is out of range because there aren't that many capture groups in the regex, it puts an empty string there.
>
> So make sure you are capturing group or groups in your regex.
>
> For example `^[A-Z]+-\d+$` won't work on branch name like BRANCH-1111
> But `^([A-Z]+-\d+)$` will

## Predefined branch name prefix

In situations where certain naming pattern is used for branches, this can be used to populate new branch creation with a static prefix.

Example:

Some branches:

- jsmith/AB-123
- cwilson/AB-125

```yaml
git:
  branchPrefix: "firstlast/"
```

It's possible to use a dynamic prefix by using the `runCommand` function:

```yaml
git:
  branchPrefix: "firstlast/{{ runCommand "date +\"%Y/%-m\"" }}/"
```

This would produce something like: `firstlast/2025/4/`
